{{Top|leg}}
'''Flechétte missiles''' were a type of dart-shaped projectile weapon, typically around eleven [[Centimeter/Legends|centimeters]] long. They were carried aboard the [[BTL-S8 K-wing assault starfighter]] and had the ability to follow their targets.
